name: io.github.SK-DEV-AI/websearch
description: Multi-engine web search + fetch MCP server (10 tools): parallel fan-out across DuckDuckGo, Bing Web/News RSS, Tavily, Wikipedia, arXiv, Google News RSS, Google AI Mode, plus intent-gated verticals (MDN, Stack Exchange, GitHub, HN, Semantic Scholar, OSV/NVD vulns, grep.app + Sourcegraph code, GDELT news). Consensus-merge dedup, a local cross-encoder reranker, Groq synthesis with grounding checks, a real-browser browser_action tool, and SSRF-validated fetching with PDF/EPUB/DOCX support.

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Groq keys for synthesis and query rewriting.
